items.stem: Which Zero Trust principle is applied when every access request is authenticated and authorised using all available signals?

options.rationale: Correct: 'verify explicitly' means authenticating and authorising on every available data point.
Least privilege limits how much access is granted. It does not cover how each request is checked.
Assume breach is about limiting blast radius and segmenting access.
Defense-in-depth is a layered security model, not one of the three Zero Trust principles.

items.stem: Which service gives you a cloud-native SIEM with SOAR capabilities?

options.rationale: Defender for Cloud does CSPM and workload protection. It is not the SIEM.
Correct: the skills outline places SIEM/SOAR concepts under Microsoft Sentinel.
Azure Firewall is a network security service.
Compliance Manager tracks regulatory compliance posture.

items.stem: A user must give a second form of verification only when signing in from an unfamiliar country. Which Entra capability enforces this?

options.rationale: SSPR lets users reset passwords. It does not set sign-in conditions.
Correct: Conditional Access policies use signals such as location to require MFA.
PIM gives just-in-time privileged roles. It does not enforce location-based MFA.
Access reviews recertify existing access from time to time.
